QuestInfo.name: 3rd Acclimation Training
QuestInfo.0: I shall receive the 3rd Acclimation Training from #b#p1102000##k.
QuestInfo.1: This time, the monster in question for the Acclimation Training is #r#o9300273##k. He warned me that the monster has quite a temper and that I better be careful. I better return to #bthe 1st Drill Hall#k and hunt #o9300273#s. \n\n#o9300273##r #a207031##k
QuestInfo.2: You defeated all 20 #o9300273# monsters. #p1101002# has a mission for you, now that you've reached Lv. 13.

0.0: Are you ready to start the next training session? You did receive the blessing from #p1101001#, right? Then let's get this started. This is the final chapter of the Acclimation Training, which means after you pass this, you will be pressed into real duties!

yes.0: This time, your target is a #o9300273#. They look vicious and ill-tempered, but i think you can take #r20#k of them. Head to the end of the #b1st Drill Hall#k.

no.0: Your real Knight duties are coming up soon. Aren't you excited? Get this training session over with so you can take on the real duties!

1.0: I see that you have eliminated all the #o9300273#s. Great work there! Do you feel like you can do well out of this island and in the Victoria Island?

yes.0: This marks the end of the Acclimation Training sessions. You'll do well and not only survive, but thrive in Victoria Island. You will be thrown into fire, but I believe in you enough that you will find no trouble persevering through all that!
yes.1: Your true duties begin now. Once you reach Level 13, talk to #p1101002# and he will give you a list of duties you'll have to take on. Please serve and honor the Empress well, and do not engage in activities that may jeopardize your standings in the Cygnus Knights.

mob.0: You haven't defeated #r20 #o9300273##k dummies yet. I'm telling you, there are a lot of themd own at the #b1st Drill Hall#k. Just go there and hunt them.
